content.text:
Not unless a lead signs off first. December 22nd is inside the year-end code freeze (Dec 15 to Jan 5), which exists because Finance runs the annual close then. No production release may go out in that window, hotfixes included, unless a lead in #fin-eng approves it in the channel beforehand.

Here is what to do:

- **Get sign-off now.** Ask a lead in #fin-eng to approve a Dec 22 release, and tell them what the fix is and why Finance needs it before the holidays. Keep the approval in the channel.
- **Or release before the freeze.** Tagging by Dec 14 needs no exception. That is probably the safer option if the fix is ready by then.
- **If it goes ahead on the 22nd:**
  - Tag from main as `v2026.12.N` once the PR template checklist is complete. CI builds and publishes.
  - Production needs a manual approval in the CI UI from someone on the billing team. Check that someone will be around to give it.
  - Dec 22 is a Tuesday, so the "no Fridays after 14:00 UTC" rule doesn't apply.
  - Any migration the fix needs must ship in the same release.

I can't grant the freeze exception myself, and the approval has to come from a lead.
